Download the archive for your platform, unpack it and start **Tapocalypse**:

| Platform | Archive | Start |
|---|---|---|
| Linux x86_64 (glibc 2.35+, Wayland or X11) | `tapocalypse-*-linux-x86_64.tar.gz` | `bin/tapocalypse` |
| Windows x86_64 | `tapocalypse-*-windows-x86_64.zip` | `bin\tapocalypse.exe` |
| macOS Apple silicon | `tapocalypse-*-macos-arm64.zip` | `tapocalypse.app` (unsigned: right-click → Open the first time) |

The game starts full screen; add `--windowed` for a resizable window. Sound is on by default: the **Sound** button or
**M** toggles it, `--mute` silences one session. Verify downloads with `SHA256SUMS.txt`.
